notes.title: 1000 Players - Update V1.1.0!
notes.notes:
Nova Core Chaos reached +1.000 players and the first update milestone has been reached! Thank you very much for downloading and playing our game! 

WHAT'S NEW?
Difficulty customizability has been added to the game! What does this mean? From now on, you can adjust the settings when you're in the game but ONLY BEFORE everyone has readied! 

Amount of lives
Want to be able to get less failed orders in a run? Or would you like to be able to extend your run with more lives? You'll be able to choose between 1 to 5 lives, depending on what kind of run you want! 

Customer timer
Are the customers not patient enough for you? Fear not! This will also be customizable in the settings screen. The lower the number, the less patient they'll be!

Move Speed
Want to add extra chaos to the game? Tweak with the movement speed! Doesn't matter if the speed increases or decreases, chaos will happen! 

HOW TO ACCESS?
Make sure that you have the latest update and you will find the menu in the pause screen!
